results.title: Announcing the NeurIPS 2026 Workshops - NeurIPS Blog
results.body: We are excited to announce the list of NeurIPS 2026 workshops. We received 477 submissions (454 valid), a significant increase over last year's numbers. From this great batch of submissions, we have accepted 102 workshops: 48, 28, and 26, to be hosted in Sydney, Paris, and Atlanta, respectively.
